known_risks: Preview deployments are protected by Vercel Authentication; the newest preview is READY but unauthenticated shell fetches land on Vercel SSO.
Production is visually upgraded and live, but full launch readiness is intentionally false until commerce, owned capture, and first-party analytics forwarding are wired.

Blueprint and Private Intel checkout URLs are provider-ready but require AGENTIC_INCOME_BLUEPRINT_CHECKOUT_URL and AGENTIC_INCOME_PRIVATE_INTEL_CHECKOUT_URL before paid checkout redirects to a payment provider.
Email capture forwards to an external system only when SUBSCRIBE_WEBHOOK_URL is configured; manual concierge email requires ACCESS_REQUEST_EMAIL and a working mailbox/MX record.
Analytics only forwards events when ANALYTICS_WEBHOOK_URL is configured.
Vercel inspection found no environment variables on the agenticincome project.
DNS lookup found no MX record for agenticincome.ai, so concierge email cannot be assumed ready.
